content:
On the eve of a major iPhone launch event, Apple just released a brand-new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here's what this update includes.

iOS 26.6.2 fixes an issue that prevented software updates over a cellular network

Apple is expected to release iOS 27 very soon, most likely next week.

However, ahead of this major release, Apple has rolled out a smaller iOS 26.6.2 update this week.

You can install iOS 26.6.2 on your iPhone by going to the "Software Update" section in "Settings".

Here is Apple's official update notes:

Given the bug fixes introduced in this update, releasing iOS 26.6.2 ahead of the expected iOS 27 launch makes perfect sense.

If iOS 26.6.1 left users unable to install iOS 27 over a cellular connection, next week could have been a major headache for both Apple and users.

But by rolling out this update early, many iPhones can have the necessary fixes in place before attempting the much-anticipated iOS 27 update.

So this version itself isn't particularly noteworthy, but the timing of its release—just before iOS 27 and its many new features arrive—is spot on.

In addition to iOS 26.6.2, Apple also released iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad, providing the exact same bug fixes.

Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Have you noticed any other changes? Feel free to share in the comments.
